prompt_rules: A printed object can have up to 8 cuts: a pocket (rounded rectangle), slot (rounded ends) or hole, each with a face, a centre at, a size [w, h] and a depth in mm. Cut from the top face for pen holes and card or phone slots; a cut into a side face makes a ceiling that needs print supports.

Keep 1.5 mm of material around every cut on its face, at least 1.2 mm under a pocket or slot that does not go right through, and 1.2 mm between two cuts (or overlap them by 0.5 mm to join them). A key-ring loop is a hole through a thin tab; no load or fit is promised.
